description: Angular component for managing and editing Y-axes settings in a time series chart widget, including form handling, drag-and-drop reordering, and validation.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartYAxesPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring Y-axes in a time series chart, supporting dynamic form controls, drag-and-drop reordering, and validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes to update axes settings.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form controls based on provided axes data, ensuring default axis exists.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: axesFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of axes controls.

methods.name: trackByAxis
methods.description: Track function for Angular's ngFor to optimize rendering.

methods.name: removeAxis
methods.description: Removes an axis at specified index and emits removal event.

methods.name: addAxis
methods.description: Adds a new axis with default settings and unique ID.

methods.name: prepareAxesFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array from a list of axes.
